text_block_list.text:
Having started streaming videos, Mayano Top Gun
became a popular streamer with her natural charm.
Yet for some reason, she seems to have stopped streaming. Today, she's been out all day like this again, but—
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you going to stream videos anymore?
...Aren't you going to stream videos anymore?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm already bored of this!
Maya has way more fun when we go out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I was happy that everyone praised me,
but I feel like that's enough for now!"
choice_data_list: And she was having so much fun, too...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine!
End of discussion about the video!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya has to buy the magazine that comes out today,
so I gotta go now!

Mayano Top Gun stormed off with a momentum
that brooked no argument.
choice_data_list: Still, I can't help but wonder...

text_block_list.text:
Hoping to find a hint, I browse through
her video archives, when—
choice_data_list: The critical comments directed at me are piling up...
I'm getting more and more hate comments...

text_block_list.text:
I helped shoot a video before,
and since then, jealous comments directed at me
had started to stand out.

Mayano Top Gun might have taken
the comment to heart and let it get to her.
choice_data_list: I need to talk to Mayano...

text_block_list.text:
There were plenty of places she might go,
but I decided to search them one by one.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wah, Trainer-chan!?
choice_data_list: Finally found you...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be...
you've been looking for Maya this whole time?"
choice_data_list: Because I learned the real reason you stopped streaming.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
D-Drop it already!
The reason is just like Maya said...
choice_data_list: Thank you for looking out for me.
Thank you for worrying about me
Critical comments don't bother me at all!
It's a waste to quit streaming.
It'd be such a waste to quit streaming.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
D-Drop it already!
The reason is just like Maya said...
choice_data_list: Thank you for looking out for me.
Thank you for worrying about me
Critical comments don't bother me at all!
It's a waste to quit streaming.
It'd be such a waste to quit streaming.

text_block_list.text:
When I told her I saw the critical comments directed at me
and thanked her for her kindness—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not it!
Maya really just got tired of it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Taking a break from streaming made me realize that racing is where Maya shines the brightest after all!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I want to keep running right beside Trainer-chan, doing my best and making a splash—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It made me want to captivate
even more people than ever before~!
choice_data_list: Mayano...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez!
Don't make that face!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "As long as I'm with you, Trainer-chan, Maya's happy no matter what we're doing!"
I silently nod at Mayano Top Gun's words.

Because I realized there was no need
to go out of my way to expose the gentle lie she told.
Instead, as her Trainer, I will grant her wish and help her shine—
choice_data_list: I'll make you happy no matter what, you hear!
I'll make you happy no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fueh!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer-chan!
What was that just now... !?
choice_data_list: I'll make you the most dazzling Umamusume of them all!
I'll make you shine brighter than any other Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Ohh, so that's what it was.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Then Maya will make a vow too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's gonna become a lady who sparkles
just as bright as that star!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Together with Trainer-chan, of course☆

"So when I told her to just keep streaming
freely and relaxed as she always had—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya's curious!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It leaves such a bad taste! It's so frustrating! Trainer-chan always works so hard!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whether it's with training or shooting videos, you're always helping Maya out...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, it's all Maya's fault...
Even though it was Maya's fault...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, you dummy, dummy!
Blame Maya moreeeeee!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*.
choice_data_list: Sorry about that.
Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~.
That's what I'm talking about...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I like how kind you are, Trainer-chan, but you should only be super kind to Maya!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "You're totally allowed to get super mad at comments calling you a 'nuisance' or 'worthless', okay?!"
choice_data_list: Whether I'm in the way or not, let the race decide.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Geez!
You're really hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You got it! For my sweet Trainer-chan,
Maya will take first place!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And then, let's prove everyone wrong!

I nodded and looked up at the night sky,
where a sea of stars shone brightly,
as if showing the way forward to our future.

I saw the critical comments directed at me,
but quitting streaming just because of that would be a waste.

When I mention that everyone seemed to be
having a lot of fun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"That may be true, but I hate it
when you say mean things to me, Trainer-chan..."
choice_data_list: If you tell them how you feel right now, I'm sure they'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Maya will try talking to everyone one more time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Um... it's been a while, everyone!
It's Maya-chin Channel, got it?

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener A: Maya-chin!? The real deal!?
Listener B: I missed you so much!
Listener C: Does she seem a bit down?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry, okay?
There's something I want to tell everyone today—

Having said that much, Mayano Top Gun looked down.
She was probably hesitating on how to broach the topic.
choice_data_list: (Go for it, Mayano...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Maya had a lot of fun streaming.
And I was so happy everyone watched too!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still... seeing all those harsh comments about Trainer-chan made Maya really sad.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Both Maya and Trainer-chan are working hard
saying, "We're gonna win this race!"...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I want everyone to cheer for Maya and the others, but... would they not like Maya if I'm not having fun?"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener D: I love you!!
Listener E: Sorry about that, Maya-chin...
Listener F: Yeah, I took it a bit too far..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad... But you know, I'm thinking
of putting the Mayachin Channel on pause for a bit."
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"While running during my day off, I realized something!
Races are where Maya can shine the brightest!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's a little sad, but... I want everyone to see an even more wonderful Maya!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener G: Is this really goodbye...?
Listener H: This hurts too much..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener I: I'll always support you, Maya-chin!
Listener J: Me too!
Listener K: I'm coming to see you, Maya-chin!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We can always see each other in races!
Maya will be waiting on the turf!

At the mock race held a few days later,
even more fans than usual showed up to cheer.
